vedic_reference.note: The name Devaj is derived from the Sanskrit word deva, which is a term used in Hinduism and Jainism to refer to a god or a divine being. The suffix -j is used to denote a male person. In Vedic literature, the term deva is used to refer to the gods and goddesses in the Hindu pantheon. The name Devaj is thus a powerful and sacred name that is rooted in the rich tradition of Hindu mythology and Vedic literature.
